hook.text: When the 16th Amendment passed in 1913, the Bureau of Internal Revenue came back to life.

buildup.text: Only 1% of Americans owed income tax in 1913. The form was simple because the tax applied to so few.

discovery.text: The bureau had 4,000 employees in 1913. By 1920, it had 15,000. The institution grew as fast as the tax base expanded.

twist.text: The original 1040 asked for total income and a few deductions. Today's instructions run 200+ pages.

climax.text: 1913 established the permanent income tax and the permanent bureaucracy to collect it. Both have only grown since.

punchline.text: One-page Form 1040 in 1913. 200 pages of instructions today.

quiz.question: What percentage of Americans owed income tax when the 16th Amendment passed?
